title: CSEG3060 · Unit I · L01 — Understanding the Research Problem

questions.label: Why did a 90%-accurate model fail?
questions.question: Why did a 90%-accurate model fail in the field? Choose the single best explanation — you must commit.
options: The model was overfitted — more training data would have fixed it.
Bad engineering — slow internet and poor cameras are implementation issues.
The problem was 'classify a clean image', not 'screen patients in a clinic'.
The nurses were not trained properly — human factors, not research.

questions.label: Sort these six — task, project or research problem
questions.question: Label each one: T (task), P (project) or R (research problem).

parts.prompt: Add dark mode to your college fest website.
Build a full attendance-management system with face recognition.
Fine-tune BERT on an Indian legal corpus and report F1.
Determine whether attention pruning degrades accuracy more on code-mixed Hindi–English text than on English.
Migrate the department database from MySQL to PostgreSQL.
Measure whether GitHub Copilot changes the defect density of code written by first-year students.
